summary: PLDT Inc. filed a Form 6-K with the SEC on 14 May 2026 reporting its Board of Directors' approval to acquire the remaining 65.1% equity interest in Radius Telecoms, Inc. The filing does not disclose the purchase price, premium, or other deal terms. The board approved the transaction, but no advisor names are mentioned. As this is a foreign private issuer filing under Philippine exchange rules, the acquisition is expected to be structured as a cash or stock transaction pending regulatory clearances. What to watch: further regulatory filings to reveal valuation, financing source, and closing timeline; risk-arb will depend on disclosed price and premium.
